completed_steps.summary: Classified as monolith with 1 part (project_type_id=web, Next.js 15 + Supabase + Tailwind 4)
Found ~37 existing docs (README, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, _bmad-output planning + implementation artifacts, RLS verification)
Tech stack: Next.js 15 RSC + Server Actions + Supabase + Tailwind 4 + shadcn (new-york/zinc) + Vitest 4 + GH Actions CI on main

Generated docs/api-contracts.md (14k), docs/data-models.md (16k), docs/component-inventory.md (11k). Surfaced drift: planning architecture mentions latest_version_id col that does not exist in current schema; FK target mix between profiles and auth.users.
Wrote docs/source-tree-analysis.md (15k) with annotated trees for src/, supabase/, _bmad-output/.
Wrote docs/development-guide.md (12k) and docs/deployment-guide.md (9.2k). Discovered .github/workflows/ci.yml existed (initially missed); CI gated to main only — flagged as gap.
Single-part monolith — multi-part integration architecture not applicable.
Wrote docs/architecture.md (23k) — comprehensive AS-IS technical architecture with 4 request paths, RLS-as-authorisation model, MCP server design, drift section vs planning artifacts.
Wrote docs/project-overview.md (7.8k). Other supporting docs already produced in steps 4-6.
Wrote docs/index.md (9.1k) linking all generated docs and existing CLAUDE.md/README/BMAD planning + per-story implementation artifacts.

Validation complete: 9/9 required docs generated (contribution-guide skipped — no CONTRIBUTING.md; integration-arch skipped — monolith). No incomplete markers. 3 minor architectural findings recorded inside the docs (drift, CI gap, manual rollback in two-table mutations).

findings.api_endpoints: 1 HTTP route (POST/OPTIONS /api/mcp), 1 OAuth callback, 6 page routes, 4 MCP tools, ~25 Server Actions across 7 feature modules
findings.data_tables: 8 tables (profiles, prompts, prompt_versions, prompt_snapshots, collections, collection_prompts, user_api_keys, user_ai_providers); 9 functions/triggers; weighted FTS via tsvector
findings.ui_components: 12 shadcn primitives, 8 cross-feature shared, 13 feature-local; 18 client components total; no global state library

FK targeting inconsistency: prompts.user_id -> profiles(id) but other user-owned tables FK auth.users(id) directly
CI gated to main only; develop branch (default integration) ungated
Manual rollback in savePrompt/duplicatePrompt should be a Postgres transaction
